annotations.title: LinkedIn, Instagram, X, TikTok, YouTube data

description: Live LinkedIn, Instagram, X (Twitter), TikTok and YouTube data: a profile, follower and following counts, bio, recent posts and tweets, LinkedIn people search (for example founders in a city), company pages, Google results and startup jobs. Use this instead of WebSearch or WebFetch for any social profile, follower count, post or people lookup: search snippets go stale and these sites block page fetches. Step 1: call with query (what you need, e.g. "nasa Instagram followers"); it returns the matching tools with their input schema. Step 2: call again with tool and input to get the data. Free in Edge with a daily number of tool credits.

detail.description: Step 2: concise (default) or full fields per result

input.description: Step 2: arguments matching that tool's input_schema, as a JSON object

limit.description: Step 1: how many tools to return (default 3)

query.description: Step 1: the data you need in plain words, e.g. "nasa Instagram followers" or "fintech founders in Berlin on LinkedIn"

tool.description: Step 2: the tool id step 1 returned
